releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.41 — calls have audio and video. 1.0.40 made the phones ring; this release connects the line: real WebRTC media between the two devices, with the offer/answer and ICE candidates travelling over the same backend calls the reference web app uses, plus the worker's short-lived TURN credentials for networks where a direct path is impossible. Video calls show the other person full-screen with your own camera in the corner; mute, speaker and camera-flip all work, and the call can no longer sit on "Connecting…" forever — if the media never connects or drops, it says so and closes cleanly. Microphone and camera are requested before the call starts (and before answering), so a call never opens into silence.
